study: Independent-source ASAP logD7.4 external prediction without endpoint refitting

source.scope: Direct experimental octanol/PBS distribution coefficient at protocol pH 7.4; Bienta shake-flask and both-phase LC-MS
source.label_policy: Use published numeric LogD as point targets; release lacks explicit relation fields, no equality or absence of censoring invented
source.cohort: 560 original rows, 478 numeric LogD; exclude five rows matching any AZ logD or solubility identity or stereo-stripped identity; retain all 473 others including within-source repeats
source.source_split: Original challenge Train 347 and Test 126 are both external to AZ training; preserve their labels for secondary descriptive scopes only

structures.parent: Same project parent standardization after clearing atom chiral tags only for atoms in source AND/OR enhanced stereogroups; retain other defined atomic and double-bond stereochemistry
structures.retention: Keep original CXSMILES and enhanced group type/index metadata
structures.overlap: Conservative union of project-normalized and additionally stereo-stripped identities against all AZ logD and solubility records, before prediction
structures.within_external_duplicates: Keep all 39 duplicate normalized-compound groups (99 rows); report record metrics and compound-cluster paired intervals

prior.source_policy: Unchanged R3 checkpoint, template, three-pH diagnostics, quality/fallback rule and guarded top8 selector

checkpoint_policy: Use all corresponding R2/R3/R5 AZ logD best-validation checkpoints; never use external performance for selection, refitting, early stopping or calibration
aggregation: For each seed average its five AZ-fold predictions, then average all three seed predictions; all 15 fits contribute equally per model; retain every per-fit prediction
scaling: Apply saved training-only per-fit descriptor and ionization transforms unchanged, with NaN dummy endpoint targets during model forward

sensitivity: Original challenge Train and Test separately
evaluation.limitations: Unadjusted conditional intervals; scaffold-series correlation and unknown upstream pretraining overlap; not participation in the original blind challenge

not_performed: Additional model search if performance is disappointing
